title: Graham Hancock on Joe Rogan: the sarcophagus as a place for raising consciousness

tellings.quote: Graham Hancock gets to a point where he's now saying on the Joe Rogan thing, well, perhaps it's not a sarcophagus. Perhaps it's a place where you lay down inside of.

plain: The stone box inside the Great Pyramid at Giza, usually called a sarcophagus or coffin, may not have held a body at all but may have been a place where a living person lay down to reach a higher state of mind. The researcher Luke Caverns tells Michels that the author Graham Hancock, who writes about lost ancient civilizations, has now come to suggest this on Joe Rogan's podcast, The Joe Rogan Experience. If it were so, the pyramid would be a place for ritual or altered awareness rather than a tomb.
